summary: Lift to 2 m, translate 4 m and land on the neighbouring pad. The smallest useful hop.
name: Hop 2 m - pad to pad

summary: Vertical climb to 5 m, 3 s hold, straight back down onto the launch pad.
name: Hop 5 m - vertical

summary: Climb to 10 m, fly 8 m east, hold over the target pad and descend in a vertical column.
name: Hop 10 m - 8 m lateral transfer

summary: Strict-corridor climb to 20 m, 3 s hold, controlled descent to 6 m and landing.
name: Hop 20 m - high vertical

summary: Low slalom through two gates inside a strict 1 m corridor, then land on pad B.
name: Hop 3 m - strict slalom

summary: Fast diagonal transfer at up to 4 m/s using the wide tilt cone, landing on a far pad.
name: Hop 6 m - agile 16 m transfer

summary: The reference scenario: 18 m, 1 m/s sink, cold rotor spooled up in flight, direct landing.
name: Landing 18 m - nominal descent

summary: 14 m horizontal offset at 30 m with a drifting 3 m/s sink; rotor near hover.
name: Landing 30 m - offset high altitude

summary: Falling at 6 m/s from 25 m: the plan must brake hard before the approach cone.
name: Landing 25 m - 6 m/s fast sink

summary: 4 m/s diagonal wind with 3 m/s gusts from 15 m and 10 m offset; routed approach.
name: Landing 15 m - crosswind and gusts

summary: Start over home, divert 13 m to a remote pad through a strict corridor.
name: Landing 15 m - divert to remote pad

summary: Starts tilted 12/-8 deg and tumbling at 20 deg/s; recovers attitude, then lands.
name: Landing 20 m - attitude upset recovery

summary: 2x sensor noise and a 1 cm COM box; soft 0.12 m/s touchdown after a low hold.
name: Landing 12 m - noisy sensors and COM offset

summary: Rotor stopped while falling at 2 m/s from 12 m: spool-up race before braking.
name: Landing 12 m - cold-rotor drop

summary: Climb to 10 m and hold for 20 s in a 6 m/s gusty crosswind, then land.
name: Hover 10 m - station keeping in gusts

summary: Four 3 s precision holds on the corners of a 5 m square at 6 m, strict corridor.
name: Hover 6 m - survey box

summary: Low 60 s hold with the energy objective; watch state of charge and pack temperature.
name: Hover 4 m - 60 s endurance hold

summary: Challenge: Five 8 s captures from 3 to 18 m, alternating climbs and vertical descents. Tests thrust slew and settling after altitude reversals.
name: Hover challenge - altitude ladder

summary: Challenge: Eight 5 s holds with 0.25 m capture radii in a strict 0.75 m corridor. Repeated centre returns reverse lateral tracking demand.
name: Hover challenge - precision compass

summary: Challenge: Five 10 s holds around a 12 m box at 6-14 m. Suggested 4 m/s wind, gusts, sensor noise and COM offset test combined disturbance rejection.
name: Hover challenge - gust staircase

summary: Challenge: Four 45 s holds separated by 8 m transfers and altitude changes. Tests station keeping as battery voltage falls; 180 s total dwell.
name: Hover challenge - endurance relocation

summary: Challenge: A 24 x 16 m figure eight with nine fly-through gates at up to 4 m/s. Alternating bank demand ends in a full-stop capture above home.
name: Hop challenge - fast figure eight

summary: Challenge: Four 24 m traverses at up to 4 m/s, full-stop reversals and 6-12 m altitude changes. Tests braking and thrust-vector reversal before a remote landing.
name: Hop challenge - reversal shuttle

summary: Challenge: Eight rising gates spiral to 24 m at up to 3.5 m/s, followed by a remote capture and vertical descent. Sustained turning competes with climb thrust.
name: Hop challenge - climbing spiral

summary: Challenge: Eight alternating gates across 40 m, rising and falling between 5 and 11 m at up to 2.5 m/s. Strict 1 m corridor tests coupled vertical and lateral tracking.
name: Hop challenge - weaving altitude corridor

summary: Challenge: Starts at 45 m with 8 m/s sink and 6.7 m/s lateral speed. Brake through an offset gate, settle at 16 m, then stage the precision descent.
name: Landing challenge - high-energy capture

summary: Challenge: A 30 m start feeds three descending approach gates and two stop captures. Strict 0.75 m corridor and 0.12 m/s touchdown demand precise energy management.
name: Landing challenge - strict descending dogleg

summary: Challenge: Divert past home to a pad 24 m away through descending gates. Suggested 6 m/s crosswind and 5 m/s gusts test lateral braking and terminal centring.
name: Landing challenge - crosswind diversion

summary: Challenge: Starts at 40 m, tilted 20/-15 deg with 30/-20/15 deg/s body rates and 5 m/s sink. Arrest, recapture, translate and land with suggested sensor noise.
name: Landing challenge - upset and recovery sequence

summary: Challenge: 1.3-1.5 m holds on a 3 m square with 0.2 m capture in a strict 0.5 m corridor, just above the 0.8 m route floor: a braking overshoot has almost no height to sag into.
name: Hover challenge - low-level precision square

summary: Challenge: 75 s of holds at 35, 35 and 20 m in a 6 m/s crosswind with 5 m/s gusts, then a 15 m column descent through the wind: long-exposure drift and trim.
name: Hover challenge - 35 m station in strong gusts

summary: Challenge: a serpentine 10 x 10 m grid of eight 4 s holds alternating 7.5 and 6 m, 0.3 m capture in a strict 0.75 m corridor: ten rest-to-rest captures back to back.
name: Hover challenge - 3 x 3 raster survey

summary: Challenge: seven 0.5 m steps at 5-5.5 m, each held inside 0.15 m for 6 s, with BNO085-class attitude and gyro noise: settling and overshoot, not distance.
name: Hover challenge - 0.5 m micro-steps with IMU noise

summary: Challenge: three 180 deg hairpins 4 m apart on 12 m legs at 3 m/s; every hairpin reverses the lateral velocity inside a 1 m corridor.
name: Hop challenge - hairpin switchbacks

summary: Challenge: a 16 m square flown through its 90 deg corners at 2.5 m/s in a strict 0.75 m corridor; the tube is narrowest exactly where the turn needs the most lateral acceleration.
name: Hop challenge - square corners strict

summary: Challenge: 36 m at 1.4-3.2 m above ground through five gully and ridge gates in a strict 0.5 m corridor; the 0.8 m route floor leaves little height to trade for speed.
name: Hop challenge - low-level terrain following

summary: Challenge: 72 m at 4 m/s through three offset gates, then a full stop over a remote pad: long-range speed holding and a hard braking capture.
name: Hop challenge - 72 m cross-field sprint

summary: Challenge: three 9 m climbs and dives every 6 m of ground track (~56 deg flight path) at 3 m/s: alternating near-full-thrust climbs and floor-limited descents.
name: Hop challenge - altitude sawtooth

summary: Challenge: arrive at 5 m/s, pass over the pad at 12 m instead of landing, fly a 14 m go-around circuit and re-establish a stable hover before touchdown.
name: Landing challenge - overshoot and go-around

summary: Challenge: two tightening turns (8 to 4.5 m radius) from 30 m to 9 m at 3 m/s in a 1 m corridor, then a column descent: sustained turning while shedding altitude.
name: Landing challenge - tightening helical descent

summary: Challenge: 4.5 m up, 5 m/s sideways and sinking 0.8 m/s: shed the lateral speed without the altitude the 0.8 m floor would need, in a light breeze.
name: Landing challenge - low-altitude lateral arrest

summary: Challenge: tilted, spinning and sinking 4 m/s at 38 m, then a routed 40 m transfer to a remote pad under wind, gusts, sensor noise and a CoM offset at once.
name: Landing challenge - combined stress to remote pad
